blocks.html: We created a game similar to “Papers, Please”. We wanted there to be more interaction by having the player swivel in a chair to each different workstation. We wanted to create an atmosphere that was eerie and made the player constantly second-guess their choices.

items: Created room layout and exterior scenes
Created a sound system to efficiently play audio
Made all 3D animations and particle effects
Created the menu screen and pause menu UI
Created a dialogue system that could match voice acting audio
